channel.title: Glade Updates
channel.description: Updates for Glade, a macOS JSONL and Markdown workspace.

item.title: Glade 1.0.0
item.description:
Glade’s first stable release

  • Browse files in the sidebar, scan records in a spreadsheet, and double-click a row to inspect its full JSON.
  • Find text across records or within one line. Submit searches with Return, combine column contains/equals filters, and save reusable queries for matching schemas.
  • Keep your column order, widths, and hidden fields across files with the same keys. Timestamp previews omit shared components while the inspector preserves the original value.
  • Give files local nicknames, select multiple rows, apply color tags, and filter to tagged records. Tags return when you reopen the file.
  • Scroll with reusable native table cells and cached row previews, with a simplified toolbar for copying and inspection.
  • Read Markdown with heading navigation and receive signed automatic updates through release, beta, or alpha channels.
